<!-- pr-reviewer: e0659a68fa5b5041be1045d806cca7f3c7eb9472 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge (delta review of the hand-resolved merge of main).

What I checked, from `git show --remerge-diff e0659a68f`:
- The only hand-resolved file is `pages.rs`; the real resolution is 3 files: `pages.rs` (the PR's `super::tool_settings::contents(ui, state, true)` kept, the old inline body and preview dropped), `tool_settings.rs` (+7) and `tool_preview.rs` (+20/-2).
- #2026 (left-hand taps): the "Left-hand tap (posting unavailable)" check row in `tool_settings.rs` is character-for-character main's block (`kind == 4`, `check_row`, `thread_hand` Left/Right). The state, apply and refusal-at-post parts of #2026 live outside `pages.rs` and merged cleanly. `tap_hand_tests` stays in `pages.rs` and drives `tool_editor_window`.
- #2010 (body replaces the holder): the `if body.is_some() { Tool { holder_len: 0.0, ..t.clone() }.profile() }` outline and the comment change match main's diff in `tool_preview::draw`. The `#[cfg(test)] draw_tool_preview` wrapper calls `draw(.., wide = true)`, and main's `tests/tool_preview.rs` is unchanged and hangs off `tool_preview.rs`.
- I diffed main's changes to `pages.rs` since the merge-base against the result: nothing else was dropped. The earlier review's points (catalog filters, shared form keeping main's waterjet Apply refusal, no dependency/build/`.github` change, no snapshot PNG change) are untouched by the merge.

Results merged with main (locally on macOS, own worktree, own target; no GitHub runner; trial merge with current `upstream/main` is clean):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 857 passed, 6 ignored (incl. `tap_hand_tests` x2, `tool_preview_tests` x4) |
| ui suites `tap_hand`, `sinker_setup`, `machine`, `shell`, `operations` | 3, 2, 6, 21, 31 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking): the merge commit's `Co-Authored-By` names a different model than this session's attribution; harmless.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
